_source: Default composable definitions from snooty-parser's rstspec.toml, as enumerated in the 'Composable Tutorials Guidance' doc (Appendix > Default Selections): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rOJ5RF4xDdw4OBSej9m2nb_U5tIXOLz3sYCB6P4DpcI
_sync: Re-sync option counts from https://github.com/mongodb/snooty-parser/blob/master/snooty/rstspec.toml when the default composables change.
_usage: Values are the number of options in each default composable definition, used to compute permutation counts (permutations-over-50). A docset's snooty.toml [[composables]] entries take precedence over these defaults.
